name: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: Each Gaussian has time-varying $(\boldsymbol{\mu}_t, q_t)$ tracked via local-rigid + ARAP / isometry constraints.
summary: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting renders time-varying scenes by assigning time-varying position and rotation to Gaussian primitives, explicitly tracking particle motion to avoid the flicker and storage issues of per-frame baselines.
